roles.name: Ghost Mage (Only Role)
powers: Your Arcane skill is your current Arcane skill or Intelligence +3.
For your combat check, you may discard a card to use your Arcane skill +2d8 and add the Attack, Force, and Magic traits. This counts as playing a spell.
If a monster deals damage to you, roll 1d4; on a result other than 1, reduce the damage to 0. Do this each time a monster deals damage to you.
During your turn, discard a card to examine the top card of your location deck. If the examined card is an ally or a monster, immediately encounter it; otherwise, return it to the bottom of the deck.
At the end of the scenario, or if your character dies, shuffle your discard pile into your deck and replace this role card with your own.
If you win the scenario, draw 1 random card of each type of boon other than loot from the box. This counts as a scenario reward.
